title: ui colour vision (schema 1)
description: ui/data/colour_vision.json: the colour-blind presets. For Tools to add to tools/schemas (proposal from UI; map.json would send ui/data/colour_vision.json to it). Version field: schema. Policy: closed. `map` keys are colour roles (UiLook.ROLE_HEX) and values hex colours; `lanes` is the two fighters' lane colours by neutral fighter id (copied from data/art/colour-vision.json, which Art owns; a hud_check case compares them).
